title: Good food, good laughs, great value!
text:
I had an AMAZING time!! 💜 
Listen-- we experienced non-stop laughs. My group was lively! We were all super engaged. We took this tour for my husband's 40th birthday. Found the tour from TikTok and it lived up to the hype!!! Transparent coaching about buying from THE MARKET which I loved... the tour is great.
Cooking was fun! You do not have to have ANY culinary background to do it but you will learn skills. I was in charge of dessert (which was chefs kiss btw)
I would come back here a million times for the vibes and food alone! 10/10
If you're looking for something fun to do, I HIGHLY RECOMMEN
author: dorindac746

title: Yummy and fun
text: If you do the 10am DO NOT eat breakfast before. I was so full after I needed to be rolled out of there. Food is delicious and Claudia did a lovely job of explaining the history of the dishes in a low key fun way. I'm pretty confident I could make a paella after this as well so thats a plus.
author: cassidyl664

title: Amazing Time
text: Our experience was amazing and Claudia was the best host ever. I highly recommend this experience for anyone looking to enjoy cooking and eating some good food in Spain.

title: When in doubt, cook it out!
text: epic fun! If you doubt about cooking class by all means, please do it. Best way to get to know people and the culture.
author: rynoinps

title: Had an amazing time (from Hong Kong)
text: This was a great experience! We not only got to explore the market but the chef also provided a lot of back story and history around it which made it more interesting for us. Also, it was a very inclusive and hands on experience with the very unique 10 tapas tasting at the start! 10/10 would recommend.
author: isaaccQ8289CZ

title: Great experience at Barcelona
text:
We had an absolutely amazing experience! From the moment we arrived, everyone made us feel welcome and relaxed. The atmosphere was warm, fun, and very professional.

Alfredo  was outstanding—patient, knowledgeable, and passionate about Spanish cuisine. Every step was explained clearly, and we learned so many useful cooking techniques while having a great time. The ingredients were fresh and of excellent quality, and the paella we prepared was one of the best we have ever tasted.
